attributes.name: Druva - Rare High Severity Event Type
attributes.description: Detects rare high severity event type in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 8 – Behavioral Correlation & Threat Hunting

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 8 – Behavioral Correlation & Threat Hunting
meta.customer_usecase: Detects rare high severity event type in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE event.severity >= 7 AND druva.event_type IS NOT NULL
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
